description.value:
Duration constant

Your limit on Afflicted you may control at once increases by 1. This is permanent and applies at all times; it does not stack with itself if the feat is somehow gained twice. It does not make raising an Afflicted cheaper, faster, or longer-lasting.

cinderfall.incomplete: Afflicted is this class's minion subsystem: a raise-cap, a collapse timer, and (at level 18) a shared cross-actor Resonance pool. pf2e's schema has no generic "max controlled minions" field, no "minion lifespan" field, and no mechanism for one actor's rule element to modify a different actor's stats on an ongoing basis. No schema field for "max controlled minions" exists to increment.
